newsitem.title: USA: Tracor unit gets $130 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Tracor unit gets $130 million contract.

text.p: Tracor Information Systems Co. said Wednesday its Cordant unit has won four new contracts with a potential value of $130 million as part of a multiple award from the Virginia Contracting Activity.
Each of the contracts, which have no definite delivery dates and quantities, will last either two or five years, the company said in a statement.
Tracor Information Systems is a unit of Tracor Inc., a defence electronics firm based in Austin, Texas, with 1996 sales of $1 billion.
Tracor's stock rose 75 cents to $25.50 on Nasdaq at midday.
